title: Down or misconfigured? Orders cannot reach payments
query: Orders started throwing connection errors to payments right after we changed some settings. Is payments actually broken, or did we break something on the orders side?
root_cause: Orders was deployed with a wrong payments endpoint (wrong port), so every payment call is refused.

remediation.detail: Roll orders back to the previous version and configuration (v1.0.0).

evidence: Deploy log shows an orders config change just before the errors
Orders logs show connection errors to a payments address that does not answer
up for payments is 1, so payments itself is not down
